# TCF Canada Expression Écrite Simulator
> Free, interactive, full-exam simulator for the TCF Canada (Test de Connaissance du Français) written expression test (Expression Écrite).

- Website: https://tejaspatel083.github.io/tcf-writing-simulator/
- Language: French (Primary, interface available in French & English)
- Purpose: Exam preparation, immigration to Canada (Express Entry, PNP, Quebec)
- Target Audience: Candidates preparing for TCF Canada / TCF IRCC / TEF Canada

## What is this tool?
The TCF Canada Expression Écrite Simulator is a free web application designed to replicate the exact official testing conditions of the TCF Canada written examination administered by France Éducation International.

Candidates preparing for Canadian Permanent Residency (IRCC Express Entry, CLB 7+ / NCLC 7+) can practice writing essays, letters, and opinion articles under real exam pressure with official timers, automated word counts, and instant AI evaluation.

## Key Features
- **Real Exam Conditions (60 Minutes)**: Full exam simulation with the standard 60-minute countdown timer spanning all 3 consecutive tasks.
- **Single Task Practice Mode**: Targeted training on Task 1 (15 min), Task 2 (20 min), or Task 3 (30 min) with customizable timer durations.
- **Extensive Past Exam Topics (2024 - 2026)**: Regularly updated question bank containing real exam combinations organized by year and month.
- **All 3 Official TCF Canada Tasks**:
  - **Tâche 1 (Message/Courriel)**: Short message, email, or invitation (60–120 words).
  - **Tâche 2 (Article/Récit)**: Narrative article or personal experience report for a newspaper/blog (120–150 words).
  - **Tâche 3 (Texte d'opinion)**: Comparison of two short documents and argumentative synthesis presenting personal viewpoint (120–180 words).
- **Official Word Count Rules**: Enforces strict word counting following official TCF Canada exam guidelines (hyphenated words, apostrophes, and minimum/maximum boundaries).
- **AI-Powered Evaluation**: Instant diagnostic feedback evaluating Vocabulary, Grammar & Morphology, Structure & Coherence, and Task Fulfillment according to the official CEFR scale (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2 / NCLC level).
- **Error Tracking & Mistakes Notebook ("Mes Fautes")**: Automatically logs recurring spelling, grammatical, and syntax errors across test sessions to help candidates improve before test day.
- **Works on Desktop & Mobile**: Clean, tactile neumorphic user interface with French accent virtual buttons for quick typing on any keyboard.
- **Free & Cloud Synced**: Option to practice as a guest or sign in to save test history and monitor progress over time.
